ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and in linear striations; approximate 85:15 dark-to-light pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters concentrated at the far lateral margins (left and right tips); distinct high-contrast white patch on the inner-distal portion of the left lobe; low-intensity dark field across the central and proximal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; base of vertex partially obscured by water line; visible angle approximately 55-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; higher frequency of peaks observed on the inner-trailing edges relative to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal sweep; convex curvature on the outer trailing edge transitioning to a concave trajectory approaching the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) aggregated on the outer lateral tips and extreme trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear pixel disruptions; specifically three parallel diagonal rake marks on the lower-mid left lobe and various shorter vertical striations across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scarring) across the ventral surface and heavy calcified deposits on distal lobe margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical white pigmentation patch on the interior distal quadrant of the left lobe.
